title: Lutos, no irrigation, most drought-flagged years, mid-September
rationale: Lovrin carries the worst drought record in the dataset: 3 drought-flagged years in 10, a -7.9 mm last-month precipitation anomaly and a +3.7 °C temperature anomaly, with soil moisture at 0.105 m³/m³ on day 0 and no irrigation. That is the strongest support in the set for ranking the one drought_tolerance ridicata cereal, secara, above the two medie ones, grau_toamna and orz_toamna, and for asserting secara into the top — lutos is in its suitable_classes. rapita_toamna is excluded on the calendar as in the irrigated Lovrin case: all Banat, west/north and national windows closed before 2026-09-13.
